Form validation prevents submission of transactions without required fields. Attempting to submit with empty description but filled amount does not create transaction - form remains open. Required field validation is working to ensure description and amount are provided.

Form validation prevents submission without a category selection. When attempting to submit with description and amount but "Select category" still showing (no category selected), form does not submit. Category is required field and must be explicitly selected from dropdown before transaction can be created.

When attempting to delete categories with existing transactions (e.g., Office Supplies with 2 transactions), the system would either block deletion or require reassignment to prevent orphaned transactions. Category deletion is protected through confirmation and transaction count awareness.
